items.t: "Steveston South" is a Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® sub-area name, not a City of Richmond planning-area name. The City plan covering the ground is the Steveston Area Plan.
Landmarks on the South Arm waterfront include Garry Point Park (12011 7th Avenue) and the Steveston Harbour Authority site at 12740 Trites Road.

The Area Plan supports two- and three-storey townhouses and affordable housing along the east side of the Trites Area (No. 2 Road), while keeping existing single-family character elsewhere in Steveston.
The Area Plan limits residential buildings at the BC Packers waterfront node to four storeys over parking.

blocks.text: Steveston South: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: Garry Point Park is a waterfront park with open lawn, a Japanese-style memorial garden (Kuno Garden), the Fisherman's Memorial Needle and Scotch Pond heritage moorage. The City advises the river is unsafe for swimming.
Britannia Shipyard Park (5180 Westwater Drive) and Imperial Landing Park (4000 Bayview) are linked riverfront parks with heritage buildings and a boardwalk.
Steveston Village is the main commercial centre under the Area Plan.
Steveston Exchange is served by routes 401, 402, 406, 407 and 413 per TransLink's exchange map.

blocks.text: Steveston South: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: The Paramount node is a working commercial fishing harbour; the Area Plan supports land uses that service the fleet.
The Steveston Harbour Authority is a non-profit that leases the harbour from Fisheries and Oceans Canada.
The Gulf of Georgia Cannery (12138 Fourth Avenue) is a National Historic Site beside the harbour.
The City describes Richmond as roughly 1 m above sea level, protected by dikes it plans to raise from 3.5 m to 4.7 m.
Under Bylaw 8204, new buildings must be set back 7.5 m from a standard dike right of way.
The proposed Steveston Island dike would run about 3.3 km from Garry Point Park to London Landing, with crest heights of 4.7 to 5.5 m and a multi-decade timeline.
Liquefaction pockets are possible in a major earthquake.

faq.q: What did condos in Steveston South sell for?
faq.a: 69 condos sold in Steveston South between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $675,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Steveston South?
faq.a: The median was 29 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.8% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Steveston South sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 69 condos that sold in Steveston South went for between $567,500 and $767,500, around a median of $675,000.

faq.q: Do condos in Steveston South sell above asking price?
faq.a: 4% of the 69 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.8% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Steveston South?
faq.a: Of the 69 sales, 69 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $574.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Steveston South?
faq.a: The median year built was 1998 for the 69 condos sold in Steveston South.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Steveston South usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Steveston South had 2 bedrooms, from the 69 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
